sloka: इति प्रतिज्ञामारुह्य चरामि विपुलं तपः ।एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं मया राक्षसपुङ्गव ।। ७.१७.१७ ॥
transliteration: iti pratijñāmāruhya carāmi vipulaṁ tapaḥ ।etatte sarvamākhyātaṁ mayā rākṣasapuṅgava ।। 7.17.17 ॥

translations.english: Then, I bear in my heart the true desire of my father towards Narayana, vowing to fulfill it.
